## Statement {#section-statement}

<p>Every <a href="/articles/connectivity/">open cluster</a> of <a href="#/product-model">product percolation</a> under a row sum below one is finite, by the <a href="/tag/53Z9/">uniform row-sum bound</a>. The key estimate is <a href="#step-3">inequality (3)</a>; a comparison with the <a data-wanted="random-cluster-model">random-cluster model</a> is not needed.</p>

## Proof {#section-proof}

<p>The idea: compare connections with walks and sum a geometric series.</p>
::::details Proof of the bound $\chi_q(v)\le 1/(1-m)$
<p>Collapsed proof text mentioning the quokka estimate, with $a&lt;b$.</p>
